# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.1.1 - 2026-11-17

- Skills refreshed to `slackapi/slack-skills-plugin` commit `524163c0`: 5 skills, copied unchanged.
- Removed `slack-cli`, `create-slack-app`, `deploy-slack-app` and `test-slack-app`: they install the Slack CLI or Node and Python, or ship shell scripts.
- README: live check of the hosted endpoint.
- Recorded a live check of the hosted endpoint on 2026-11-17.

## 0.1.0 - 2026-11-10

- First version: Slack remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- Added the 9 agent skills published in `slackapi/slack-skills-plugin` (commit `99e027a4`), copied unchanged, with Slack's MIT licence in `skills/LICENSE`.
